  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="gradient" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0" gradientTransform="matrix(0 -1 1 0 0.5 1)">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#000000"/>
      <stop offset="0.33333" stop-color="#ff00ff"/>
      <stop offset="0.66667" stop-color="#00ffff"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#ffffff"/>

  </defs>
  <rect width="512" height="512" fill="url(#gradient)"/>

godot:
# Untested in Godot.
# The Gradient interpolates linearly between its points (interpolation_mode is left at its default).
# fill_from and fill_to are the CSS gradient line of 0deg in a box with aspect ratio 1:1 (width:height).
var gradient := Gradient.new()
gradient.offsets = PackedFloat32Array([0.0, 0.33333, 0.66667, 1.0])
gradient.colors = PackedColorArray([Color8(0, 0, 0), Color8(255, 0, 255), Color8(0, 255, 255), Color8(255, 255, 255)])

var texture := GradientTexture2D.new()
texture.gradient = gradient
texture.fill = GradientTexture2D.FILL_LINEAR
texture.fill_from = Vector2(0.5, 1.0)
texture.fill_to = Vector2(0.5, 0.0)
texture.width = 256
texture.height = 256

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- Untested on device. A shape gradient cannot hold this many stops, positions or this angle, so the gradient is a VectorDrawable fill. -->
<vector xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android" xmlns:aapt="http://schemas.android.com/aapt"
    android:width="100dp"
    android:height="100dp"
    android:viewportWidth="100"
    android:viewportHeight="100">
    <path android:pathData="M0,0h100v100h-100z">
        <aapt:attr name="android:fillColor">
            <gradient
                android:type="linear"
                android:startX="50"
                android:startY="100"
                android:endX="50"
                android:endY="0">
                <item android:offset="0" android:color="#FF000000" />
                <item android:offset="0.33333" android:color="#FFFF00FF" />
                <item android:offset="0.66667" android:color="#FF00FFFF" />
                <item android:offset="1" android:color="#FFFFFFFF" />
            </gradient>
        </aapt:attr>
    </path>
</vector>
